plan: Drive: from Mica Creek, about 67 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 51.85344, -117.85661, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk: 14 km W, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 2,420 m, about 521 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 190 m S of the spot at 855 m (51.83877, -118.05861). Water: unnamed wetland right here (estimate).
Hunt: moose, Sept, Oct (season rows). Glass the wetland and cutblock edges at dawn and dusk. Move slowly, stop often (Tip).
Use: .308 Winchester, 165 to 180 grain premium bullet, shots inside about 200 m (219 yd) (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 4-37, Region 4. No baiting in Region 4. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-09-10, closures 2026-10-16.
R4F-moose-backcountry-0002.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 4-37: about 318 hunter days a year for moose (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.14 days per square km, middle third of BC MUs; access: more than 5 km from a drivable road. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
